about: The source model of a Zeiss CZI file (ZISRAW; spec/virtualize/czi.md, spec/virtualize/czi/profile.md §13): the elements a parser emits, the tables of pixel types and compressions, and the roles a segment, a directory entry, a subblock, an attachment, an image or a tile array plays, each with the constraints a file must meet to have the CZI convention's layout. A parser checks this schema while it parses, at the point the profile meets each role; projections read a valid IR and check nothing.

pixel_types.about: PixelType: name, data type, samples p, bytes per pixel q

compressions.about: Compression: name, and the pixel types it admits

elements.about: The IR of a CZI file. Names in angle brackets are variables; `run` marks where a parser folds consecutive identically shaped siblings into one run. Every segment has its 32-byte `header` {id:cstr[16],allocated_size:<i8,used_size:<i8}; a segment two entries name (one FilePosition) is described once, the second name an alias.

children.data: data (placed: geometry, codec, recipe; uncompressed pixels, or a Zstd1 payload after its header) or bytes[n]

children.xml: ascii[x] (not decoded into the IR: read for the layout, streamed)

children.data: CZTIMS, CZFOC: struct of size, count, values <f8[c]; CZEVL: struct of size, count, events (one array of records when no event has a description, else events/<e> and descriptions/<e>); Zip-Comp, ZIP: derived (gzip, not inflated); else bytes

segments/<k>.about: the walk's segments nothing references, in file order

tail.type: bytes: from where the walk stops to the end

segment.about: a segment a position names, read where the profile reads it

given.within: its 32-byte header is within the file

constraints.message: {what}'s position {position} is not an offset from 0 to 2^53 - 1
{what}'s segment header is outside the file
{what} at {position} is not a {expected} segment
{what}'s AllocatedSize {allocated} is not a size from 0 to 2^53 - 1
{what}'s UsedSize {used} is not a size from 0 to 2^53 - 1
{what} is outside the file
CZI file version {major}.{minor} (Major MUST be 1)
FilePart {file_part}: a CZI split over several files is not supported
{what}'s EntryCount {count} is not from 0 to {maximum}

given.ends: it ends within the directory's used bytes

constraints.message: directory entry {i} does not end within the directory's used bytes
a directory entry is outside the file
directory entry {i} has schema {schema}, not DV
directory entry {i} is in FilePart {file_part}
directory entry {i} has an unsupported PixelType {pixel_type}
directory entry {i} has an unsupported Compression {compression}
directory entry {i}: Compression {compression} with PixelType {pixel_type}
directory entry {i} has DimensionCount {dimension_count}, not 2 to 12

dimension.about: a dimension of a directory entry

given.letter: the letter, when the id is a letter and three NULs
given.repeated: an earlier dimension has the letter

constraints.message: directory entry {i} has the dimension {letter}
directory entry {i} has the dimension {letter} twice
directory entry {i}'s {letter} Size and StoredSize must be at least 1
directory entry {i}'s {letter} Size and StoredSize must be 1
directory entry {i} lacks the X or Y dimension

subblock.about: a subblock's header, after its segment header

constraints.message: subblock {i} has a negative MetadataSize, AttachmentSize or DataSize
subblock {i}'s copy of its entry has schema {schema}, not DV
subblock {i}'s copy of its entry has DimensionCount {dimension_count}, not 0 to 40
the metadata segment has a negative XmlSize or AttachmentSize
attachment entry {k} is in FilePart {file_part}
attachment {k}'s DataSize {data_size} is not a size from 0 to 2^53 - 1

image.about: a series with an image: its levels (spec/virtualize/czi.md §3.5)

constraints.message: an image of {levels} levels, more than {max_levels}
{images} series with an image, more than {max_images}

extent.about: each dimension of an image's or a tile array's shape (spec/virtualize/czi.md §4.2): a tile array's y and x are its coded size

constraints.message: an array dimension of {extent}, more than 2^31

given.all_finite: every scale and translation value is finite

constraints.message: a translation is not finite

about_builtins: What the parser's code computes and the roles above check: a subblock's coded size from its codec header (spec/virtualize/czi.md §3.2: Zstd0 and Zstd1 frame headers, a JPEG frame header, JPEG XR's image size and pixel format, within the first 2^16 bytes of its data); placement (a subblock whose copy of its entry agrees with the directory's and that has a coded size; an entry whose subblock another entry names first is not placed again); series, layers, levels, tiles and row bands (spec/virtualize/czi.md §3.3–§4.4, layout.py), with a band floor: when the largest divisor band of an uncompressed tile holds less than band_floor bytes, bands are the most rows within max_band bytes and the last band of each tile row is shorter (a rectilinear grid); the metadata XML's values (§2.7) in one streaming pass, with no tree (an end tag closes back to the innermost open element of its name, found by a count per name); the walk over the segments nothing references (spec/virtualize/czi/profile.md §13.2 step 6).
